title: Looker Login and Access Audit
dataSources: Looker System Activity (`history`, `pdt_builds`, `scheduled_plan`, `event`, `api_usage`), Looker API queue/PDT metrics, GCP audit logs for Looker Studio and BigQuery-backed reports.
app: Looker System Activity and Admin API via HEC scripted inputs; Looker Studio and BigQuery-backed usage via the Splunk Add-on for Google Cloud Platform (`Splunk_TA_google-cloudplatform`).
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=looker:system_activity view=event event_type IN ("login","login_failure","permission_denied")
| stats count as events, sum(eval(event_type="login_failure")) as failures by user_id
| where failures>5
| sort - failures
description: Audits Looker sign-in and permission events and flags users with repeated failed logins or denied access for troubleshooting and abuse detection.
value: Repeated failures can mean a locked-out analyst or a credential attack; auditing access keeps Looker both usable and secure.
implementation: Query the `event` System Activity view; schedule hourly; alert on bursts of failures.
visualization: Table of users by failures, timechart of failed logins.
grandmaExplanation: We keep a record of who signs in to Looker and flag lots of failed tries, which could be someone locked out or an intruder.
